Subject: Intro phone screen — times (20m)

Hi Idan,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Software Engineer role and for your patience. I’d love to set up a quick 20-minute initial phone screen to go over your background and answer any questions about the role/team. Below are a few windows that work on my side — I listed them in PST since a lot of our hiring team is stateside. If none of these work, feel free to propose 2–3 alternatives and your timezone.

- Tue 11/7, 8:00–10:00 AM PST
- Wed 11/8, 9:30–11:30 AM PST
- Thu 11/9, 4:00–6:00 PM PST

What to expect: a 20-minute chat focused on your recent infra/serving work, a quick talk through your resume, and next steps if we both want to move forward.

If we lock something we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and a dial-in. Also — feel free to attach an updated resume if you have one.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
